one_line_description: Tool to help teams organize, track, and manage their work.
auth_methods_evidence: Your app may ultimately use OAuth, but most developers test our API by creating a Personal Access Token (PAT) to make their first API calls.
self_serve_evidence: Create your token or app in the developer console.
buildability_rationale: Self-serve with good docs, broad API, OAuth2 or API key authentication, no gating, and Composio-supported.
agent_notes: Asana offers both OAuth2 and Personal Access Token authentication methods. The API is well-documented with an embedded API explorer. The Composio registry shows 153 tools available, indicating a broad API surface.
verification_note: Note: agent found [api_key, oauth2] but Composio lists only [oauth2]. Asana genuinely supports both (Personal Access Tokens + OAuth2); Composio chose to implement only OAuth2. Agent is correct.
